text: At its meeting of on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, City Council adopted Item 2022.NY33.7, approving a Rental Housing Demolition Application to demolish and replace 46 rental dwelling units at 241 Redpath, including the provision a Tenant Relocation and Assistance Plan secured in a Section 111 Agreement. The Approval Report can be found here . Tenants were provided with assistance based on an estimated 36-month displacement period. After tenants vacated the existing building, the project was delayed. In this case, the Section 111 agreement requires additional tenant support in the event of delayed occupancy, in the form of a top-up rent gap payment, to be paid when tenants sign a lease agreement for a replacement rental unit, rather than the current practice of payments in six-month increments following the expected occupancy date.
